arxiv-2102-06542.title: Method for Calculating Excited Electronic States Using Density Functionals and Direct Orbital Optimization with Real Space Grid or Plane Wave Basis Set
arxiv-2102-06542.creator: Aleksei V. Ivanov, Gianluca Levi, Elvar Ö. Jónsson, Hannes Jónsson
arxiv-2102-06542.description: Abstract A direct orbital optimization method is presented for density functional calculations of excited electronic states using either a real space grid or a plane wave basis set. The method is variational, provides atomic forces in the excited states, and can be applied to Kohn-Sham (KS) functionals as well as orbital-density dependent functionals (ODD) including explicit self-interaction correction.

arxiv-2103-00040.title: Spin Berry points as crucial for ultrafast demagnetization
arxiv-2103-00040.creator: G. P. Zhang ∗, Y. H. Bai, Thomas F. George
arxiv-2103-00040.description: Abstract Laser-induced ultrafast demagnetization has puzzled researchers around the world for over two decades. Intrinsic complexity in electronic, magnetic, and phononic subsystems is difficult to understand microscopically. So far it is not possible to explain demagnetization using a single mechanism, which suggests a crucial piece of information still missing.

arxiv-2209-10585.title: Grape Cold Hardiness Prediction via Multi-Task Learning
arxiv-2209-10585.creator: Aseem Saxena, Paola Pesantez-Cabrera, Rohan Ballapragada, Kin-Ho Lam, Markus Keller, Alan Fern
arxiv-2209-10585.description: Abstract Cold temperatures during fall and spring have the potential to cause frost damage to grapevines and other fruit plants, which can significantly decrease harvest yields. To help prevent these losses, farmers deploy expensive frost mitigation measures such as sprinklers, heaters, and wind machines when they judge that damage may occur.

arxiv-2212-04571.title: Kondo Effect in Defect-bound Quantum Dots Coupled to NbSe 2
arxiv-2212-04571.creator: T. R. Devidas, Tom Dvir, Enrico Rossi, Hadar Steinberg
arxiv-2212-04571.description: Abstract We report the fabrication of a van der Waals tunneling device hosting a defect-bound quantum dot coupled to NbSe 2 . We find that upon application of magnetic field, the device exhibits a zero-bias conductance peak. The peak, which splits at higher fields, is associated with a Kondo effect.

arxiv-2305-09667.title: Mass and Color Dependence of the Hubble Spiral Sequence
arxiv-2305-09667.creator: Petra Mengistu, Karen L. Masters
arxiv-2305-09667.description: Abstract In the classic Hubble spiral sequence, arm windiness correlates with bulge size; Sa type spiral galaxies with larger bulges also have the most tightly wound spirals. Exceptions to this have long been known, and in recent work using Galaxy Zoo morphologies no strong correlation was seen in a volume limited sample.

arxiv-2305-12384.title: From Patches to Objects: Exploiting Spatial Reasoning for Better Visual Representations
arxiv-2305-12384.creator: Toni Albert, Bjoern M. Eskofier, Dario Zanca
arxiv-2305-12384.description: Abstract As the field of deep learning steadily transitions from the realm of academic research to practical application, the significance of self-supervised pretraining methods has become increasingly prominent. These methods, particularly in the image domain, offer a compelling strategy to effectively utilize the abundance of unlabeled image data, thereby enhancing downstream tasks’ performance.

arxiv-2311-02690.title: Relative Arbitrage Opportunities in an Extended Mean Field System
arxiv-2311-02690.creator: Nicole Tianjiao Yang, Tomoyuki Ichiba
arxiv-2311-02690.description: Abstract This paper studies relative arbitrage opportunities in a market with infinitely many interacting investors. We establish a conditional McKean-Vlasov system to study the market dynamics coupled with investors. We then provide a theoretical framework to study a mean-field system, where the mean-field terms consist of a joint distribution of wealth and strategies.

arxiv-2405-00285.title: iMTSP: Solving Min-Max Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem with Imperative Learning
arxiv-2405-00285.creator: Yifan Guo, Zhongqiang Ren, Chen Wang*
arxiv-2405-00285.description: Abstract This paper considers a Min-Max Multiple Traveling Salesman Problem (MTSP), where the goal is to find a set of tours, one for each agent, to collectively visit all the cities while minimizing the length of the longest tour. Though MTSP has been widely studied, obtaining near-optimal solutions for large-scale problems is still challenging due to its NP-hardness.

arxiv-2409-03473.title: Purification of Gaussian States by Photon Subtraction
arxiv-2409-03473.creator: Kun Zhang, Huijun Li, Jietai Jing, Nicolas Treps, Mattia Walschaers
arxiv-2409-03473.description: Abstract Photon subtraction can enhance entanglement, which for pure states induces a decrease in the purity of reduced states. In contrast, by analyzing the purities of Gaussian states before and after subtracting a single photon, we prove that the purity of a Gaussian state can also be increased by less than 20%.

arxiv-2504-17443.title: Morphisms and BWT-run Sensitivity
arxiv-2504-17443.creator: Gabriele Fici, Giuseppe Romana, Marinella Sciortino, Cristian Urbina
arxiv-2504-17443.description: Abstract We study how the application of injective morphisms affects the number r r of equal-letter runs in the Burrows–Wheeler Transform (BWT). This parameter has emerged as a key repetitiveness measure in compressed indexing. We focus on the notion of BWT-run sensitivity after application of an injective morphism.

arxiv-2505-00316.title: Surrogate modeling of Cellular-Potts Agent-Based Models as a segmentation task using the U-Net neural network architecture
arxiv-2505-00316.creator: Tien Comlekoglu, J. Quetzalcóatl Toledo-Marín, Tina Comlekoglu, Douglas W. DeSimone, Shayn M. Peirce, Geoffrey Fox, James A. Glazier
arxiv-2505-00316.description: Abstract The Cellular-Potts model is a powerful and ubiquitous framework for developing computational models for simulating complex multicellular biological systems. Cellular-Potts models (CPMs) are often computationally expensive due to the explicit modeling of interactions among large numbers of individual model agents and diffusive fields described by partial differential equations (PDEs).

arxiv-2505-24273.title: How Much Backtracking is Enough? Exploring the Interplay of SFT and RL in Enhancing LLM Reasoning
arxiv-2505-24273.creator: Hongyi James Cai, Junlin Wang, Xiaoyin Chen, Bhuwan Dhingra
arxiv-2505-24273.description: Abstract Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) suggest that reinforcement learning (RL) effectively internalizes search strategies, yielding significant improvements on challenging reasoning tasks through extended chains of thought. While backtracking is widely viewed as the core mechanism enabling this improvement, its precise dynamics and how SFT and RL interact to optimize for it, remain poorly understood.

arxiv-2509-09845.title: Meta-Analysis with JASP, Part I: Classical Approaches
arxiv-2509-09845.creator: František Bartoš, Eric-Jan Wagenmakers, Wolfgang Viechtbauer
arxiv-2509-09845.description: Abstract Meta-analyses play a crucial part in empirical science, enabling researchers to synthesize evidence across studies and draw more precise and generalizable conclusions. Despite their importance, access to advanced meta-analytic methodology is often limited to scientists and students with considerable expertise in computer programming. To lower the barrier for adoption, we have developed the Meta-Analysis module in JASP ( https://jasp-stats.

arxiv-2601-02542.title: The fine spectral expansion of the Rankin–Selberg period
arxiv-2601-02542.creator: Paul Boisseau
arxiv-2601-02542.description: Abstract We state and prove the spectral expansion of the theta series attached to the Rankin–Selberg spherical variety ( GL n + 1 × GL n ) / GL n (\mathrm{GL}_{n+1}\times\mathrm{GL}_{n})/\mathrm{GL}_{n} . This is a key result towards the fine spectral expansion of the Jacquet–Rallis trace formula.

pmc-11433580.title: A Benzimidazole-Based N-Heterocyclic Carbene Derivative Exhibits Potent Antiproliferative and Apoptotic Effects against Colorectal Cancer
pmc-11433580.creator: Sarah Al-Nasser, Maha Hamadien Abdulla, Noura Alhassan, Mansoor-Ali Vaali-Mohammed, Suliman Al-Omar, Naceur Hamdi, Yasser Elnakady, Sabine Matou-Nasri, Lamjed Mansour, Maria Rosaria De Miglio, Shinobu Ohnuma
pmc-11433580.description: Background and Objectives: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a major global health issue. Although chemotherapy is the first-line treatment, its effectiveness is limited due to drug resistance developed in CRC. To overcome resistance and improve the prognosis of CRC patients, investigating new therapeutic approaches is necessary.

pmc-12609508.title: Genome-Wide Identification of the OPT Gene Family and Screening of Sb-Responsive Genes in Brassica juncea
pmc-12609508.creator: Xianjun Liu, Mingzhe Chen, Yuhui Yuan, Jialin Sheng, Pintian Zhong, Sha Gong, Zhongsong Liu, Guohong Xiang, Junhe Hu, Mingli Yan, Yong Chen, Liang You
pmc-12609508.description: Antimony (Sb), a toxic metalloid, inhibits plant growth and threatens human health. Yellow Stripe-Like (YSL) proteins play crucial roles in metal ion transport and cellular homeostasis. While the OPT gene family has been characterized in some species, its genome-wide organization and functional involvement in Sb stress response remain unexplored in Brassica juncea.

pmc-13039531.title: Comparative analysis of different biophysical techniques for exosome characterization
pmc-13039531.creator: Xiaojuan Yu, Zhaoxing Wang, Ruifeng Zhang, Wenli Guo, Qing Chang, Wendan Chu, Chengshi Zeng, Lan Wang, Chuanfei Yu, Wenqi Li
pmc-13039531.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Exosomes, as key mediators of intercellular communication, have demonstrated great potential in drug delivery. However, their accurate characterization remains challenging due to their complex physical properties. This study purified exosomes from milk and human urine using ultracentrifugation and the EXODUS systems and systematically compared several biophysical techniques to characterize them, including dynamic light scattering (DLS), nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA), NanoCoulter technology, and analytical ultracentrifugation (AUC).

pmc-13195905.title: A novel, wearable, in-ear EEG technology to assess sleep and daytime sleepiness
pmc-13195905.creator: Jonathan Berent, Prabhjyot Saini, Andrew X. Stewart, Devansh Bheda, Konstantin Borodin, Akshay Paul, Brian Tracey, Caroline Dong, Dmitri Volfson, Derek L. Buhl, David B. Rye
pmc-13195905.description: In-ear electroencephalography (EEG) has emerged as a promising alternative to traditional in-laboratory sleep studies, offering greater comfort and practicality. Here we present a novel in-ear EEG system, comparing in-ear recordings against scalp EEG channels acquired concurrently as part of polysomnography (PSG).

pmc-13287837.title: Clinical Validation of a Generative AI System for Diagnosing Ampullary Lesions: A Multicenter Study
pmc-13287837.creator: Jang Ho Kwon, Ho Seung Lee, Seong Ji Choi, Kihwan Choi, Chang Mook Kang, Hoonsub So, Young Hoon Choi, Jae Min Lee, Kyoung Joo Lee, Jai Hoon Yoon, Dong‐Sup Jin, Hyo Jung Kim
pmc-13287837.description: BackgroundAccurate histologic classification of ampullary lesions is essential for guiding therapeutic decisions; however, conventional biopsy is limited by sampling error and false‐negative results. We evaluated the clinical utility of a generative artificial intelligence (AI)–based computer‐aided diagnosis (CAD) system that integrates real and synthetic endoscopic images to improve diagnostic performance.

pmc-13366066.title: IFPHOR0069 The Global Opioid Access Divide: A Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Ecological Analysis of Consumption Inequality, Health System Determinants, and Drug Composition Across 201 Countries, 2015–2023
pmc-13366066.creator: Abdul Rhaman Kafagi
pmc-13366066.description: BackgroundGlobal opioid analgesic access is profoundly inequitable, with 5.5 billion people living in countries with little or no access to controlled medicines for pain and palliative care. Comprehensive multi-country analyses identifying modifiable health system drivers of this divide remain limited.MethodsA retrospective cross-sectional and longitudinal ecological analysis of country-level opioid consumption was conducted across 201 countries from 2015–2023.
